By reinventing the old industry with new technology’s power, RAKSUL is delivering satisfaction and happiness to customers every day with global offices in Japan, Vietnam, and India. We have developed various products based on e-commerce platforms, whether they are incubation, growth-phase products, or long-term core business products.
We are looking for comrades to create great products in HCMC office together.
 
Main technologies
Vue.js, Typescript for Frontend
Ruby on Rails or TypeScript for Backend
